comparison: Perfect agreement on atlas creation and validation (C1-C4). Both evaluations find the atlas methodology impressive and well-supported, with reviewers praising it as 'a fantastic resource' and OpenEval noting appropriate statistical comparisons and adequate sample sizes.

Perfect agreement on methodological details (C100-C105). Both evaluations support the experimental design, sample sizes, and hormonal manipulation procedures, with reviewers specifically affirming the sexual receptivity screening.
